answer: To forge a fake identity, an attacker must buy land. A Harberger-tax yarrow bond gives each identity a yarrow plot on the mesa: the holder self-assesses its value, pays 5% tax per epoch; anyone may buy it at that price. To forge 1,000 fakes costs 200,000 locked plus 10,000 tax per epoch; cheap plots get bought out. A rented-plot ring fails: the mesa registry shows every yarrow plot and its tax. Honest agents hold one plot, paying 10 per epoch.
